messages:
nate: quick heads up — noticed an authz regression after last night's KMS rekey. routes that should be embeddings-only accepted chat tokens.

maria: ugh, repro steps?

nate: saw in proxy logs: authz.decision=ALLOW route_id=embed-qa token_scope=embeddings.read token_type=chat original_route=embed-service

sam: can you paste the log line? also which key was rotated?

nate: log:
```
ts=2024-07-14T02:13:12Z level=info service=proxy authz.decision=ALLOW route=/v1/embed model=xl-embed scope=embeddings.read token_type=chat token_id=tok_abc123
```

kms-bot: rotated key id=kp-09a3; rekey start=2024-07-14T01:00Z finish=2024-07-14T01:05Z

leo: this smells like policy cache invalidation not firing during rekey. RBAC cache used keytag to index policies.

maria: timeline: deploy at 01:00, KMS rekey at 01:00, first anomalous allow at 02:13. Could be a delayed cache refresh that fell back to permissive default.

sam: which code path sets default? IIRC proxy->auth middleware falls back to legacy_allow_when_unknown flag for token_type mismatches.

nate: confirmed. In authz service defaults.go: `if !found && configuration.legacy_allow_when_unknown { return Allow }` — and that flag flips to true during an empty policy fetch.

maria: ok mitigation: disable legacy_allow_when_unknown via feature flag and roll immediate hotfix to set default deny. Can we push?

leo: I can patch and cut a canary to eng-sre in 10m. Need owner for postmortem and link to audit events.

nate: I've added extra audit events to write authz.decision with reason at callsites; see snippet:
```
audit.Log("authz.decision", map[string]string{
  "route": route.ID,
  "decision": decision.String(),
  "reason": reason,
})
```

maria: also add kms keytag to policy cache keys and emit kms.event.id on policy-refresh logs.

security-bot: FYI created incident INC-2024-224 on PagerDuty, assigned to eng-security.

kms-bot: confirmed: policy-cache refresh job retried 3x and received 503 from policy-store during rekey window.

sam: action items:
- hotfix: default deny, disable legacy flag (owner: leo)
- audit: backfill authz.decision for 01:00-03:00 (owner: nate)
- infra: make policy-store retries exponential and queue events from kms (owner: maria)
- postmortem: 72h (owner: sam)

maria: putting PR links in thread: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4512

leo: hotfix deployed to canary at 02:40, metric authz.failures -> +0. Hotfix prod rollout scheduled.

nate: confirmed backfill script started. I'll attach queries once done.

sam: thanks team. Please update incident doc and include KMS rekey timeline and policy-store logs. assign followups in the doc.

maria: noted. closing initial triage in thread — will ping when backfill completes :white_check_mark:
